cutoff_behavior.commit_and_diff_queries: search commits reachable from cutoff_commit and exclude dates after cutoff

query_families.purpose: Find explicit agent or co-author trailers in commit messages.
query_families.query_template: repo:^{sourcegraph_repo_regex}$@{cutoff_commit} type:commit (Co-authored-by:.*(Claude|Copilot|Codex|Devin|Cursor)|Assisted-by:.*(Claude|Copilot|Codex|Devin|Cursor)|Generated-by:.*|AI-Generated:.*|Agent:.*) after:"2023-01-01" before:"2026-07-25" fork:yes archived:yes count:all timeout:1m patternType:regexp

query_families.purpose: Find commits authored or committed by recognized agent accounts; identity matches remain candidates.
query_families.query_template: repo:^{sourcegraph_repo_regex}$@{cutoff_commit} type:commit (author:(devin-ai|copilot|cursor|codex|claude) OR committer:(devin-ai|copilot|cursor|codex|claude)) after:"2023-01-01" before:"2026-07-25" fork:yes archived:yes count:all timeout:1m patternType:regexp

query_families.purpose: Find added disclosures that explicitly describe generated or agent-authored code.
query_families.query_template: repo:^{sourcegraph_repo_regex}$@{cutoff_commit} type:diff select:commit.diff.added (generated|authored|implemented).{0,80}(Claude|Copilot|Codex|Devin|Cursor|agent) after:"2023-01-01" before:"2026-07-25" fork:yes archived:yes count:all timeout:1m patternType:regexp

query_families.purpose: Find repository-local announcements or instructions describing agent adoption.
query_families.query_template: repo:^{sourcegraph_repo_regex}$ rev:{cutoff_commit} file:(README|CHANGELOG|CONTRIBUTING|AGENTS|CLAUDE|copilot-instructions|\.cursor) (adopted|using|migrated|generated|agent) fork:yes archived:yes count:all timeout:1m patternType:regexp

query_families.purpose: Find repository-local policies that may prohibit AI-generated code contributions.
query_families.query_template: repo:^{sourcegraph_repo_regex}$ rev:{cutoff_commit} file:(CONTRIBUTING|CODE_OF_CONDUCT|README|POLICY|AGENTS|NO_AI) ((AI|LLM|generative).{0,240}(prohibit|forbid|ban|reject|not.accept|do.not.use|not.allowed)|(prohibit|forbid|ban|reject|not.accept|do.not.use|not.allowed).{0,240}(AI|LLM|generative)) fork:yes archived:yes count:all timeout:1m patternType:regexp

query_families.purpose: Date the default-branch commit that introduced or materially changed a candidate AI-ban policy.
query_families.query_template: repo:^{sourcegraph_repo_regex}$@{cutoff_commit} type:diff select:commit.diff.added file:(CONTRIBUTING|CODE_OF_CONDUCT|README|POLICY|AGENTS|NO_AI) ((AI|LLM|generative).{0,240}(prohibit|forbid|ban|reject|not.accept|do.not.use|not.allowed)|(prohibit|forbid|ban|reject|not.accept|do.not.use|not.allowed).{0,240}(AI|LLM|generative)) after:"2023-01-01" before:"2026-07-25" fork:yes archived:yes count:all timeout:1m patternType:regexp

evidence_packets.content_addressing: sha256 of canonical JSON excluding packet_sha256
required_context_enrichment: blame when the evidence is file content
evidence_packets.candidate_event_order: earliest observed timestamp first, commit OID as deterministic tiebreaker

adoption_event.confirmed: A default-branch commit has independently verifiable agent-generation provenance and a datable scope.
adoption_event.observed: A recognized agent account, agent trailer, or adoption announcement is datable but generation scope is not independently confirmed.
adoption_event.rejected: The evidence is unrelated, not on default-branch history, post-cutoff, or affirmatively contradicts adoption.
adoption_event.insufficient: The candidate cannot be resolved without inference beyond the frozen evidence.

ai_ban_policy.admissible: Repository-local policy text explicitly applies to AI or LLM generated code contributions and has a datable default-branch effective commit.
ai_ban_policy.rejected: The text is advisory, unrelated, off-repository only, not applicable to code contributions, or post-cutoff.
ai_ban_policy.insufficient: Policy scope or effective date cannot be established from the frozen evidence.

agreement_audit.selection: sha256(seed + NUL + packet_sha256) modulo 10000 below sample_basis_points
agreement_audit.effect: report agreement-audit error separately; do not silently relabel the unsampled agreements
